patches.description: Add readonly NodeCache::allocated_bytes payload accounting and its cold/inner/spill/reset regression; cache equations and policy unchanged.
Add default CacheAccess hidden-layout proof hooks delegating to existing NodeCache behavior, allowing an adapter to use its existing flag storage under the same invalidation contract.
Route hidden subtree proof reads/writes through CacheAccess hooks; traversal, nonempty-container and non-speculative marking policy unchanged.
Verify default host cache marker allocation, invalidation, leaf and speculative behavior remain unchanged.

note: Complete git source archive replaces published0.1.1; package version unchanged. No upstream performance result is asserted for the GPUI adapter.
